name: PREDICTION: Sudan Famine Expansion — Cross-Border Health Emergency

trigger.description: Sudan famine (declared North Darfur + South Kordofan) expanding to 4 additional states; cholera in all 18 states; 14M displaced; cross-border health emergency imminent
trigger.region: East Africa / Horn of Africa / Nile Basin

reasoning: Sudan is the world's largest humanitarian crisis (2026). Our Sudan 2023 backtest validated the initial cascade (6/7 within range). But the NEXT phase is predictable: famine expansion to Blue Nile and White Nile states (Q3 2026), cholera crossing into Ethiopia/South Sudan via refugee flows, and Nile water crisis as Sudan's irrigation infrastructure collapses. CascadeAI's WAR->DISPLACEMENT->HEALTH->WATER path predicts this with high confidence.

predictions.prediction: Cholera outbreak in Amhara/Benishangul-Gumuz refugee hosting areas by Q3 2026; 5,000-10,000 cases
predictions.mechanism: DISPLACEMENT(250K+ Sudanese refugees) -> WATER(camps strain water systems) -> HEALTH(cholera transmission)
predictions.data_source_to_verify: WHO Ethiopia; UNICEF WASH reports; Ethiopian Health Ministry
predictions.confidence: VERY HIGH — cholera already in all 18 Sudan states; refugee camps have documented water stress

predictions.prediction: Sudanese refugee hosting costs exceed $1.5B for Egypt by end 2026; 500K+ refugees (up from 350K)
predictions.mechanism: WAR -> DISPLACEMENT -> ECONOMY(hosting costs escalate as crisis extends)
predictions.data_source_to_verify: UNHCR Egypt; Egyptian government budget; IOM
predictions.confidence: HIGH — Egypt is primary destination; trajectory is clear from current 350K

predictions.prediction: Food prices in eastern Ethiopia (Afar, Somali regions) increase +20-30% by Q4 2026 as refugee populations compete for local food supply
predictions.mechanism: DISPLACEMENT -> FOOD(demand shock in hosting areas with already-limited supply)
predictions.data_source_to_verify: WFP Ethiopia food price monitoring; FAO GIEWS
predictions.confidence: HIGH — pattern confirmed in 2023 phase; scale increasing

predictions.prediction: Compound displacement: Sudanese refugees + climate-displaced Somalis create 500K+ new displacement in Horn of Africa by Q1 2027
predictions.mechanism: SUDAN WAR->DISPLACEMENT converges with CLIMATE->FOOD->DISPLACEMENT in Somalia
predictions.data_source_to_verify: UNHCR; IOM DTM; OCHA Horn of Africa
predictions.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH — both individual cascades are confirmed; compound effect is the prediction

predictions.prediction: Nile water crisis intensifies: Sudan's Gezira irrigation scheme (feeds 40% of Sudan's agriculture) collapses from conflict damage, reducing downstream Nile flow predictability and increasing Egypt-Ethiopia GERD tensions
predictions.mechanism: WAR -> WATER(infrastructure destruction) -> regional water diplomacy crisis
predictions.data_source_to_verify: FAO Sudan; Egyptian Ministry of Water Resources; GERD monitoring data
predictions.confidence: MEDIUM — infrastructure damage confirmed; water flow impact depends on conflict geography

key_insight: Sudan validates CascadeAI's core thesis: a crisis that started as a military coup cascaded through displacement, health, food, and water systems over 3 years. We predicted this path in 2023. Now we're predicting the NEXT 12 months of spread — into Ethiopia, Egypt, and the Nile basin. If we're right again, that's the strongest possible evidence for the platform.
demo_moment: 'In our Sudan 2023 backtest, we got 6 out of 7 predictions right. Now here are our NEXT 5 predictions for the Sudan cascade — cholera in Ethiopian refugee camps, Nile water crisis, compound displacement in the Horn. Check back in 6 months.'
